ल: ल The twenty-eighth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, the letter L.

ल m. (लः) 1 INDRA. 2 Cutting. f. (ला) 1 Giving. 2 Receiving, taking. f. (ली) 1 Embracing, adhering or clinging to. 2 Liquifying, melting. E. ला to give or take, &c., aff. क or ड, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.
लक: लक r. 10th cl. (लाकयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
लक n. (-कं) 1 The forehead. 2 The ear or spike of wild rice. E. लक to taste, &c., aff. अच्.
लकच: लकच m. (-चः) A tree: see the next.
लकुच: लकुच m. (-चः) A species of the bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus Lacucha, Rox.) E. लक to taste, उच aff.; also अ substituted for उ, लकच.
लक्तक: लक्तक m. (-कः) 1 Old and tattered cloth, a rag or rags. 2 Lac, the dye. E. लक to obtain, aff. क्त, and कन् added.
लक्तकर्मन्: लक्तकर्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A tree used in dyeing, a red variety of the Lodh tree. E. लक्त for रक्त coloured, and कर्म्मन् office, act.
लक्ष: लक्ष r. 10th cl. (लक्षयति-ते) 1 To see, to look at, to notice or inspect. 2 To mark, to make any mark on. 3 To define, to discriminate. With उप prefixed, To remark. With सम्, To know, to understand.
लक्ष nf. (-क्षं-क्षा) A Lac, one hundred thousand. n. (-क्षं) 1 Fraud, disguise. 2 A mark or butt. E. लक्ष to mark, or see, aff. घञ्.
लक्षण: लक्षण n. (-णं) 1 A mark, a spot. 2 A name, an appellation. 3 Sight, seeing. 4 An indication, a predicate, any thing by which an object is designated or distinguished. 5 A symptom or any indication of actual disease. m. (-णः) 1 The younger brother of RĀMA. 2 The Indian crane. f. (-णा) 1 The female of the Indian crane. 2 A goose. 3 An ellipsis, a word, &c. understood, though not inserted. 4 The force or application of a word or phrase. E. लक्ष to see, to mark, aff. ल्युट्, or लक्ष as before, Uṇādi aff. न, and अट् augment; also with मुट् augment, लक्ष्मण, which in the masc. and fem. forms is the more usual reading.
लक्षित: लक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Seen. 2 Marked. E. लक्ष to mark, aff. क्त.
लक्ष्मण: लक्ष्मण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Prosperous, fortunate. m. (-णः) 1 The son of DAŚARATHA by SUMITRĀ, the half-brother and faithful companion of RĀMACANDRA. 2 The Sāras or Indian crane. n. (-णं) 1 A mark, a spot or sign. 2 A name, an appellation. f. (-णा) 1 The female of the Sāras. 2 A kind of drug. E. लक्ष to mark or see, Uṇādi aff. न, and मुट् augment; also with अट् augment, लक्षण as above.
लक्ष्मणप्रसू: लक्ष्मणप्रसू f. (-सूः) SUMITRĀ, one of DAŚARATHA'S four wives, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA. E. लक्ष्मण, प्रसू the mother.
लक्ष्मन्: लक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 1 A mark, a spot, a sign. 2 Chief, principal. E. लक्ष to mark, &c., मनिन् aff.
लक्ष्मी: लक्ष्मी f. (-क्ष्मीः) 1 LAKṢMĪ, one of the three principal female deities of the Hindus, the wife of VIṢṆU, and goddess of wealth and prosperity. 2 Fortune, success, prosperity. 3 SĪTĀ the wife of RĀMA. 4 Beauty, splendour. 5 The name of a medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi. 6 Another root, termed Ṛddhi. 7 A plant: see प्रियङ्गु. 8 The wife of a hero. 9 Turmeric. 10 A pearl. E. लक्ष to see, &c., Uṇādi aff. ई, and मुट् augment.
लक्ष्मीगृह: लक्ष्मीगृह n. (-हं) The red lotus. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, and गृह abode, appearing at the creation, floating over the water on the expanded petals of the lotus.
लक्ष्मीपति: लक्ष्मीपति m. (-तिः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a sovereign prince. 3 The clove tree. 4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel) E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of prosperity, and पति master, husband.
लक्ष्मीपल: लक्ष्मीपल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
लक्ष्मीपुत्त्र: लक्ष्मीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 KĀMADEVA, the god of love. 2 A horse. 3 Either of the sons of RĀMA and SĪTĀ. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, or SĪTĀ, (she being LAKṢMĪ. incarnate,) and पुत्त्र a son.
लक्ष्मीपुष्प: लक्ष्मीपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A ruby. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and पुष्प a flower.
लक्ष्मीमत्: लक्ष्मीमत् m. (-मान्) The bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.) E. लक्ष्मी prosperity, मतुप् aff., and the म unchanged.
लक्ष्मीवत्: लक्ष्मीवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Prosperous, fortunate, wealthy, thriving. 2 Beautiful. E. लक्ष्मी prosperity, and मतुप् poss. aff.
लक्ष्मीश: लक्ष्मीश m. (-शः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The mango tree. 3 A prosperous man. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess of fortune, and ईश lord.
लक्ष्मीसहज: लक्ष्मीसहज m. (-जः) The moon. E. लक्ष्मी the goddess, सह with, ज born; rising as well as LAKṢMĪ from the ocean, at the time it was churned by the gods and Asuras.
लक्ष्य: लक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be seen or noted. 2 To be defined or described. 3 To have attributes or predicates attached. n. (-क्ष्यं) 1 A mark, a butt. 2 A mark, a sign. 3 Fraud, disguise. 4 A Lac, a hundred thousand. E. लक्ष to see, यत् aff.
लख: लख r. 1st cl. (लखति) (इ) लखि (लंखति) To go, to move, to approach.
लग: लग(ए,)लगे r. 1st cl. (लगति) To be with or near, to touch, to be in contact or union with. (इ) लगि r. 1st cl. (लंगनि) 1 To go or move. 2 To go limpingly, to be lame. r. 10th cl. (लागयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain.
लगित: लगित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Obtained, gained. 2 Connected with, attached to. E. लग to be in contact with, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.
लगुड: लगुड m. (-डः) 1 A staff, a stick. 2 An iron club, or one bound with iron. E. लग to go, aff. डुलच्, and ल changed to ड; also लगुर.
लगुर: लगुर m. (-रः) A club, a stick. E. see the last; ड changed to ल.
लगुरहस्त: लगुरहस्त m. (-स्तः) A man armed with a stick, a mace or staffbearer. E. लगुर, and हस्त the hand.
लग्न: लग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 1 Attached to, intent on. 2 Ashamed. 3 Joined to, connected with. n. (-ग्नं) The rising of a sign, its appearance above the horizon; the oblique ascension, or the divisions of the equator, which rise in succession with each sign in an oblique sphere; also defined as the arc of the equator, which passes the meridian in the same time with each sign of the ecliptic; in popular acceptation it is the moment of the sun's entrance into a zodiacal sign. m. (-ग्नः) A bard, a panegyrist. E. लग to be with or near, or लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
लग्नक: लग्नक m. (-कः) A security, a surety. E. लग्न engaged or associated, (in the business,) aff. कन्.
लग्नभुज: लग्नभुज m. (-जः) Ascensional difference. E. लग्न, and भुज arm.
लग्निका: लग्निका f. (-का) A girl ten years old, one before menstruation. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. कन्, fem. form; also नग्निका.
लघ: लघ r. 10th cl. (-लाघयति) 1 To taste. 2 To obtain. (इ) लघि r. 1st cl. (लंघते) 1 To go, to move. 2 To fast, to abstain from food. (लङ्घति) 1 To dry, to dry up. 2 To diminish, to lessen. r. 10th cl. (लङ्घयति) To speak. With उत् or वि prefixed, To go beyond or over, to cross, to pass, to leap or spring over; also morally, to exceed, to transgress.
लघट्: लघट् m. (-ट्) Air, wind. E. लघि to go, अटि Uṇādi aff., and the nasal rejected.
लघटि: लघटि m. (-टिः) Air, wind. E. लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. अटिच्.
लघिमन्: लघिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Lightness, absence of weight. 2 Diminutiveness. 3 Insignificance. E. लघु light, aff. इमनिच्.
लघिष्ठ: लघिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Lightest, very light. 2 Very small, least. E. लघु light, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
लघीयस्: लघीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Lightest, most or very light. E. लघु light, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
लघु: लघु mfn. (-घुः-घुः-घ्वी-घु) 1 Light, not heavy. 2 Swift, quick. 3 Sapless, pithless. 4 Beautiful, pleasing. 5 Small, little. 6 Light, vain, frivolous. 7 Insignificant, mean, low. 8 Weak, feeble. 9 Clean, pure. 10 Short, (as a vowel.) n. adv. (-घु) Quickly, swiftly. subst. (-घु) 1 A black kind of Aloe wood or Agallochum. 2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-घुः) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) f. (-घ्वी) 1 A slight or delicate woman. 2 A small light carriage. E. लघि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the nasal not inserted.
लघुकाय: लघुकाय m. (-यः) A goat. E. लघु small, and काय a body.
लघुखद्विका: लघुखद्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead. E. लघु small, खद्विका a bedstead.
लघुगर्ग: लघुगर्ग m. (-र्गः) A kind of fish, probably a variety of the Pimelodus. E. लघु small, and गर्ग for गर्गर a fish.
लघुचेतस्: लघुचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Low-minded, frivolous. E. लघु, and चेतस् mind.
लघुजङ्गल: लघुजङ्गल m. (-लः) A sort of quail. E. लघु light, जङ्गल flesh.
लघुता: लघुता f. (-ता) 1 Lightness. 2 Meanness, insignificance. E. तल added to लघु; also with त्व, लघुत्वं.
लघुदुन्दुभि: लघुदुन्दुभि m. (-भिः) A small kettle-drum. E. लघु light, small, and दुन्दुभि a drum.
लघुपत्रक: लघुपत्रक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Śuṇḍārocanī, (Crinum?) E. लघु light, small, and पत्रक a leaf.
लघुप्रयत्न: लघुप्रयत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) Indolent, impotent. E. लघु, and प्रयत्न effort.
लघुमांस: लघुमांस m. (-सः) The francoline partridge. E. लघु light, (of digestion,) and मांस flesh.
लघुमित्र: लघुमित्र n. (-त्रं) A friend or ally of little power or value. E. लघु, and मित्र a friend.
लघुलय: लघुलय n. (-यं) The root of a fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum). E. लघु light, लय contexture (in Tatties, &c.) or लघु and लय, both meaning the same root.
लघुवासस्: लघुवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) 1 Thinly or lightly dressed. 2 Wearing clean or pure clothing. E. लघु, and वासस् vesture.
लघुवृत्ति: लघुवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) 1 Low, vile. 2 Ill done, mismanaged. E. लघु, and वृत्ति practice.
लघुवृत्तिता: लघुवृत्तिता f. (-ता) 1 Insignificance, meanness. 2 Mismanagement, bad conduct. E. तल् added to the last.
लघुमूल: लघुमूल n. (-लं) In algebra, the least root with reference to the additive quantities. E. लघु, and मूल root.
लघुहस्त: लघुहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Ready or light-handed. m. (-स्तः) A good archer. E. लघु quick, and हस्त hand.
लघूकरण: लघूकरण n. (-णं) 1 Reducing in weight or consequence. 2 Thinking little of, contemning. E. लघु, and करण making, च्चि augment.
लघूकृत: लघूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made light, reduced in weight. 2 Reduced in consequence, made insignificant. 3 Thought lightly of. E. लघु, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
लघ्वाशिन्: लघ्वाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Eating little, moderate. E. लघु, and अशिन् who eats.
लघ्वाहार: लघ्वाहार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Temperate, abstemious. E. लघु, and आहार food.
लङ्का: लङ्का f. (-ङ्का) 1 The capital of RĀVAṆA in Ceylon; the name is extended also to the island, which according to the notions of the Hindus, is much more considerable in size, and lies further from the continent than in reality; it is described as being equal to 1/12th of the equatorial circumference of the earth, and is one of the places lying under the first meridian,  whence the longitude is computed; it is thus placed in the Eastern ocean, South of Ceylon, and according to WILFORD is the peninsula of Malacca: according to some Hindu accounts also, it is distinct from Ceylon, from which island Laṅkā is said to be just visible. 2 A goddess or evil spirit, one of the Śākinīs, perhaps the same as the tutelar deity of the city of Laṅkā. 3 An unchaste woman. 4 A branch. E. लक to obtain (happiness, in which), aff. अच्, and नुग irr. augment.
लङ्कादाहिन्: लङ्कादाहिन् m. (-ही) The monkey HANUMĀN. E. लङ्का the city, and दाहिन् burner; having set fire to the city with his burning tail.
लङ्कापति: लङ्कापति m. (-तिः) RĀVAṆA the Daitya. E. लङ्का the city, and पति master, ruler; also लङ्काधिपति, &c.
लङ्कायिका: लङ्कायिका f. (-का) A plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. लक to taste, root of the 10th cl. aff. ण्वुल् fem. form, and नुम् augment; also य being changed to प, लङ्कापिका, and by a different derivation लङ्कोपिका.
लङ्कास्थायिन्: लङ्कास्थायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Residing or being in Laṅkā. m. A plant, (-नी) (Euphorbia Tirucalli.) E. लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, and स्थायिन् what abides or grows.
लङ्केश: लङ्केश m. (-शः) The Daitya RĀVAṆA. E. लङ्का the city Laṅkā, and ईश sovereign.
लङ्कोपिका: लङ्कोपिका f. (-का) A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) E. लङ्का Laṅkā or Ceylon, वप to sow or be sown, aff. क्वुन् fem. form, and the semivowel changed to its congener.
लङ्खनी: लङ्खनी f. (-नी) The bit of a bridle.
लङ्ग: लङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः.) 1 Union, association, proximate connection. 2 A lecher, a catamite. 3 Limping, lameness. E. लगि to be near or with, &c., aff. अच्.
लङ्गूल: लङ्गूल n. (-लं) The tail of an animal. E. लगि to go, ऊलच् aff., more commonly लाङ्गूल.
लङ्घन: लङ्घन n. (-नं) 1 Fasting, abstinence. 2 Going, proceeding. 3 Leaping, springing, going by leaps or jumps. 4 Jumping over or beyond. 5 Exceeding, transgressing, disregarding propriety, going beyond proper bounds. 6 Storming a fort, entering by escalade, &c. 7 Capturing a fort in any way. 8 One of a horse's paces, curvetting, bounding. E. लघि to go, to fast, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
लङ्घनीय: लङ्घनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be passed. 2 Transgressible. 3 To be fasted. E. लघि to go, अनीयर् aff.; also लङ्घ्य and लङ्घितव्य.
लज: लज r. 1st cl. (लजति) also (इ) लजि (लञ्जति) 1 To fry. 2 To affront, to insult. (ओ ई) ओलजी r. 6th cl. (लजति-ते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful. r. 10th cl. (लाजयति) To hide, to cover, to screen or clothe: also (लजति) or (इ) लजि (लञ्जयति) 1 To be manifest or apparent. 2 To shine. (इ) लजि (लञ्जयति) 1 To give. 2 To dwell. 3 To injure. 4 To be strong. 5 To censure.
लजकारिका: लजकारिका f. (-का) The sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. लज for लज्जा shame, कारिका making, shewing.
लज्जत्: लज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Being ashamed, blushing, shrinking. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, and शतृ aff.
लज्जमान: लज्जमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being ashamed. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. शानच्.
लज्जा: लज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Shame, modesty, bashfulness. E. लस्ज to be modest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
लज्जाकर: लज्जाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रा-रं) Shameful, causing shame. E. लज्जा, and कर what makes.
लज्जाकारिन्: लज्जाकारिन् mfn. (-रि-रिणी-रि) Causing or occasioning shame. E. लज्जा, and कारिन् what makes.
लज्जान्वित: लज्जान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, bashful. E. लज्जा, and अन्वित possessed of.
लज्जारहित: लज्जारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shameless, immodest. E. लज्जा, and रहित void of.
लज्जालु: लज्जालु m. (-लुः) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. लज्जा shame, हालुक् aff.
लज्जावत्: लज्जावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Modest, bashful. E. लज्जा, and मतुप् aff.
लज्जाशील: लज्जाशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bashful, modest. E. लज्जा modest, शील possessing.
लज्जाहीन: लज्जाहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shameless, impudent. E. लज्जा, and हीन void of.
लज्जित: लज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ashamed, modest. E. लज्जा Modesty, इतच् aff.
लज्ज्या: लज्ज्या f. (-ज्ज्या) Modesty, bashfulness. E. लस्ज to be ashamed, य aff.
लञ्ज: लञ्ज r. 10th cl. (लञ्जयति) 1 To be manifest. 2 To shine.
लञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) 1 A foot. 2 The end of the lower garment tucked into the waist band. 3 A tail. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 An adulteress. 2 Sleep. 3 LAKṢMĪ. 4 A current. E. लजि to be strong, &c., aff. अच्.
लञ्जिका: लञ्जिका f. (-का) A harlot, a whore. E. लजि to censure, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form.
लट: लट r. 1st cl. (लटति) 1 To be a child, to talk or be like one. 2 To speak a little.
लट m. (-टः) 1 A block head, a fool, one speaking ignorantly or foolishly. 2 Fault, defect. 3 A thief. E. लट to be or talk as a child, &c., aff. अच्.
लटक: लटक m. (-कः) A vile or contemptible man. E. लट to talk as a child, and वुन् Uṇādi aff.
लट्ट: लट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A vile or bad man, a wretch.
लट्व: लट्व m. (-ट्वः) 1 A horse. 2 A division of music. 3 A low and wild tribe, a tribe of mountaineers. f. (-ट्वा) 1 A bird said, to be a kind of sparrow. 2 A fruit, a variety of the Karanja. 3 A bad or unchaste woman. 4 Curls on the forehead or hanging down on the face. 5 Safflower. 6 A Sweetmeat. E. लट to be like a child, Uṇādi aff. क्वन्.
लड: लड r. 1st and 10th cls. (लडति लडयति) 1 To frolic, to sport or dally. 2 To loll (the tongue.) 3 To use the tongue. 4 To stir with the tongue. 5 To stir, to agitate. 6 To pain. r. 10th cl. (-लाडयति) 1 To nurse, to foster, to attend closely. 2 To shake. 3 To feel desire. (औ इ) औलडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लंडति लंडयति) 1 To shine. 2 To toss or throw up. 3 To speak.
लड्ड: लड्ड m. (-ड्डः) A wretch, a villain, a low or bad man.
लड्डुक: लड्डुक n. (-कं) A class of sweetmeats, or a sweetmeat; a sort of ball made with flour fried with oil or Ghee, and mixed with sugar and spices, and distinguished into different kinds,  according to some slight varieties in its less essential ingredients; also read लड्डक.
लता: लता f. (-ता) 1 A creeper, a creeping or winding plant in general. 2 A branch. 3 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 4 A gramineous plant, (Trigonella corniculata.) 5 Heart-pea, (Cardiospermum haliacacabum.) 6 The large Bengal creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) 7 A sort of grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 8 A vegetable and medicinal substance, commonly Latākastūrī or the musk-creeper, said to grow in the Dekshin. 9 Thread. E. लत a Sautra root, to hurt, to enfold, &c., aff. अच् and टाप्.
लताकस्तूरिका: लताकस्तूरिका f. (-का) A medicinal plant, commonly Latākastūrī. E. लता a creeper, and कस्तूरिका musk.
लताजिह्व: लताजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A snake. E. लता a creeper, and जिह्वा the tongue, which becomes masc. in the compound.
लतातरु: लतातरु m. (-रुः) 1 The orange tree. 2 The palm tree. 3 The Śāl tree. E. लता a creeper, and तरु a tree: fit for creepers to cling to.
लताद्रुम: लताद्रुम m. (-मः) A timber tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. लता a creeper, and द्रुम a tree.
लतान्त: लतान्त n. (-न्तं) A flower. E. लता a creeper, and अन्त end.
लतापनस: लतापनस m. (-सः) The water-melon. E. लता a creeper, and पनस the jack, to the fruit of which the melon may be compared in size.
लताप्रतानिनी: लताप्रतानिनी f. (-नी) A spreading creeper. E. लता a creeper, and प्रतानिनी spreading.
लतामणि: लतामणि m. (-णिः) Coral. E. लता a creeper, and मणि a jewel.
लतामाधवी: लतामाधवी f. (-बी) The Mādhavī. creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.) E. लता a creeper in general, माधबी the particular one.
लतामृग: लतामृग m. (-गः) An ape or monkey. E. लता, and मृग a deer.
लतायष्टि: लतायष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) E. लता a creeper, and यष्टि stick or stem.
लतायावक: लतायावक n. (-कं) Coral. E. लता a creeper, यावक barley, or similar grain; of similar shape.
लतारसन: लतारसन m. (-नः) A snake. E. लता a creeper, and रसना the tongue, but made masc. in the compound.
लतार्क: लतार्क m. (-र्कः) A green onion. E. लता a creeper, and अर्क to heat, aff. घञ्.
लतालक: लतालक m. (-कः) An elephant. E. लता a creeper, and अलक a curl.
लतावेष्टन: लतावेष्टन n. (-नं) Embracing, an embrace. E. लता a creeper, and वेष्टन surrounding.
लतावेष्टितक: लतावेष्टितक n. (-कं) An embrace, embracing. E. लता a creeper, (like it,) वेष्टित a surrounding or enfolding, aff. कन्.
लताशङ्ख: लताशङ्ख m. (-ङ्घः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) This word is elsewhere read लताशङ्कु or लतातरु and शङ्कुतरु.
लतिका: लतिका f. (-का) A twining plant. E. लता the same, कन् aff. fem. form.
लत्तिका: लत्तिका f. (-का) A lizard. E. लत a Sautra root, to hurt, तिकन् Uṇādi aff.
लप: लप(ऋ)लपृ r. 1st cl. (लपति) To speak, to utter. With अनु prefixed, 1 To talk like, to mimic. 2 To repeat. With अप, To deny. With आङ्, To address, to speak to, With प्र, To talk incoherently. With प्रति, To gain, to get. With वि, To lament, to bewail. With वि and प्र, To contradict, to dispute. With सम, 1 To converse, to discourse. 2 To be cunning or crafty.
लपन: लपन n. (-नं) 1 The mouth. 2 Talking. E. लप to speak, ल्युट् aff. of the instrument or act.
लपित: लपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. n. (-तं) Voice or speech. E. लप to speak, aff. क्त.
लब: लब(इ)लबि r. 1st cl. (लंबते) 1 To sound. 2 To fall or tumble, to be prostrate. With अव prefixed, 1 To hold, to support. 2 To hang from or on, to depend from. 3 To rest upon. 4 To hang with the head downwards. With आङ्, To trust in, to depend on. With वि, To delay, to detain.
लब्ध: लब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Gained, acquired, obtained, received, got. f. (-ब्धा) A woman whose husband or lover is faithless. E. लभ to get, aff. क्त.
लब्धचेतस्: लब्धचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Recovered, restored to one's senses, come to a right mind. E. लब्ध, and चेतस् intellect.
लब्धजन्मन्: लब्धजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born. E. लब्ध, and जन्मन् birth.
लब्धधन: लब्धधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wealthy. E. लब्ध, and धन wealth.
लब्धवर्ण: लब्धवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Sage, learned, a sage, a Paṇḍita. E. लब्ध got, and वर्ण praise, celebrity.
लब्धविद्य: लब्धविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Learned. E. लब्ध, and विद्या knowledge.
लब्धसंज्ञ: लब्धसंज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Revived, recovered from fainting. E. लब्ध, and संज्ञा consciousness.
लब्धावकाश: लब्धावकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Having found an opportunity or interval. E. लब्ध, and अवकाश opportunity.
लब्ध्रिम: लब्ध्रिम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Obtained. E. लभ to gain, क्त्रिमच् aff.
लब्ध्वा: लब्ध्वा ind. Having gained or got. E. लभ to get, क्त्राच् aff.
लभ: लभ(डु अष)डुलभष् r. 1st cl. (लभते) To obtain, to get or gain. (इ) लभि r. 1st cl. (लम्भते) 1 To sound. 2 To injure. 3 To revile. 4 To gain. With उप prefixed. 1 To apprehend, to understand. 2 To delay. With उप and आङ्, To revile, to abuse.
लभस: लभस m. (-सः) 1 Wealth. 2 A solicitor, one who asks or solicits. 3 A horse's foot rope. E. लभ to get, Uṇādi aff. असच्.
लभ्य: लभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) 1 Attainable, procurable. 2 Fit, right, proper. E. लभ to get, aff. यत्.
लमक: लमक m. (-कः) A lover, a gallant. E. रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. वुन्, and र changed to ल.
लम्पट: लम्पट m. (-टः) 1 A lecher, a libertine, a whore-monger, a gallant. 2 The Bakula tree.
लम्पटता: लम्पटता f. (-ता) Libertinism, dissoluteness. E. लम्पट, and तल् aff.; also लम्पटत्वं.
लम्पाक: लम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 A country, the district of Lamghan in Cabul. 2 A libertine, a lecher.
लम्पापटह: लम्पापटह m. (-हः) A kettle drum, a state drum, the Nakāra of the Muselmans.
लम्ब: लम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 1 Spacious, capacious. 2 Great, large, broad, long, expanded either in breadth or length, or both. 3 Pendulous, depending. m. (-म्बं) 1 A bribe, a present. 2 Moving a man at a sort of backgammon or draughts. 3 A perpendicular, (in geometry.) 4 (In astronomy,) The arc between the pole and zenith of any place. f. (-म्बा) 1 A name of LAKṢMĪ. 2 A name of GAURĪ or DURGĀ. 3 A bitter gourd. E. लबि to fall, to sound, aff. अच्.
लम्बक: लम्बक m. (-कः) 1 A section, a chapter. 2 A perpendicular, &c. E. लवि to fall, वुन् aff.
लम्बकर्ण: लम्बकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A goat. 2 An elephant. 3 A goblin or Rākṣasa. 4 A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) 5 A hare. 6 A name of GAṆEŚA. E. लम्ब large or pendulous, and कर्ण the ear.
लम्बज्या: लम्बज्या f. (-ज्या) Sine or cosine of the latitude. E. लम्ब, and ज्या sine.
लम्बन: लम्बन n. (-नं) 1 Depending, descending, falling. 2 A long necklace, one which depends from the neck to the navel. m. (-नः) Phlegm, the phlegmatic humour. E. लबि to fall, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
लम्बमान: लम्बमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Depending, descending, hanging or falling, going down. 2 Being large or bulky. E. लबि to fall, &c., and शानच् aff., मुक् augment.
लम्बिका: लम्बिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. लबि to hang down, aff. क्वुन् fem. form.
लम्बित: लम्बित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended, depending, falling or hanging down. E. लबि to fall down, aff. क्त.
लम्बुषा: लम्बुषा f. (-षा) A necklace of seven strings. E. लबि to depend, उषच् aff.
लम्बोदर: लम्बोदर m. (-रः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A glutton. E. लम्ब large, and उदर the belly.
लम्बौष्ठ: लम्बौष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A camel. E. लम्ब large, and ओष्ठ a lip.
लम्भन: लम्भन n. (-नं) 1 Abuse, reviling. 2 Gaining, getting. E. लभि to sound, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
लम्भयत्: लम्भयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing to get, procuring, producing. E. लभ to get, causal v., शतृ aff.
लम्भा: लम्भा f. (-म्भा) A sort of chain enclosure or fence.
लम्भित: लम्भित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Caused to get, given to, procured for. 2 Applied to, employed, adapted. 3 Spoken to, addressed. 4 Heightened, improved, rendered more perfect or intense. 5 Cherished. 6 Gained. 7 Abused. E. लभ to gain, causal form, or लभि to revile, क्त aff.
लय: लय r. 1st cl. (लयते) To go, to move.

लय m. (-यः) 1 Equal time in music and dancing. 2 Adhering or clinging to, embracing, uniting. 3 A house, a dwelling. 4 Sport, pastime. n. (-यं) 1 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Fusion, melting. E. ली to adhere to, &c., aff. अच्.
लयपुत्त्री: लयपुत्त्री f. (-त्त्री) An actress, a dancer. E. लय equal time in music, &c., and पुत्त्री the daughter.
लयालम्ब: लयालम्ब m. (-म्बः) An actor, a dancer, a mime. E. लय equal time, &c., and आलम्ब who moves to; it also occurs लयारम्भ.
लर्व: लर्व्व r. 1st cl. (लर्वति) To go, to move.
लर्व्व: लर्व्व r. 1st cl. (लर्वति) To go, to move.
लल: लल r. 1st cl. (ललति) 1 To sport, to dally. 2 To loll, as the tongue, &c.: see लड, of which it is considered as a various reading only. r. 10th cl. (लालयते) 1 To desire, to wish for, to seek to obtain. 2 To sport, to wanton. 3 To lay.
लल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Sporting, frolicking. 2 Lolling, wagging. 3 Wishing, desirous. E. लड or लल to sport, अच् aff.
ललजिह्व: ललजिह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Fierce, savage, (as a beast of prey, &c.) m. (-ह्वः) 1 A camel. 2 A dog. E. लल lapping, licking, and जिह्व the tongue.
ललत्: ललत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Shaking, tremulous. 2 Licking, lapping, stirring or touching with the tongue, lolling the tongue, &c. 3 Wantoning, dallying. E. लड to loll, to frolick, &c. participial aff. शतृ, and ड changed to ल.
ललदम्बु: ललदम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) E. लल trembling, अम्बु water.
ललन: ललन n. (-नं) 1 Pleasure, sport, pastime. 2 Lolling the tongue. m. (-नः) The Śāl tree. f. (-ना) 1 A woman in general. 2 A wanton woman. 3 The tongue. E. लड to frolic, &c., aff. ल्युट्, and ड changed to ल.
ललन्तिका: ललन्तिका f. (-का) 1 A necklace hanging as low as the navel. 2 A lizard, a chamæleon. E. ललत् sporting, lolling, &c. fem. form, and कन् added.
ललाक: ललाक m. (-कः) The penis. E. लड to frolick, aff. आकन्, and ड changed to ल.
ललाट: ललाट n. (-टं) The forehead. E. लल wish or dalliance, from लड with अच् aff., and अट् to go or be, aff. अण्; also with कन् added ललाटक n. (-कं)
ललाटतट: ललाटतट n. (-टं) The forehead. E. ललाट, and तट a bank.
ललाटन्तप: ललाटन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Burning, scorching, (as the sun.) m. (-पः) The sun. E. ललाट the forehead, तप to scorch or inflame, aff. खश्.
ललाटपट्ट: ललाटपट्ट n. (-ट्टं) 1 A tiara, a fillet. 2 The forehead. E. ललाट, and पट्ट a cloth or any flat surface.
ललाटफलक: ललाटफलक n. (-कं) The open forehead. E. ललाट, and फलक a plank.
ललाटरेखा: ललाटरेखा f. (-खा) 1 A line on the forehead, supposed to indicate long life. 2 A wrinkled or corrugated brow. 3 A coloured sectarial mark on the forehead. E. ललाट the forehead, and रेखा a line; also ललाटलेखा.
ललाटिका: ललाटिका f. (-का) 1 An ornament worn on the forehead, a jewel or star suspended there, or a kind of tiara bound over it. 2 A mark made with Sandal on the forehead. E. ललाट the forehead, कन् aff. fem. form.
ललाम: ललाम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Beautiful, agreeable, charming, (in this sense some authorities confine it to the neuter gender, and to its use compounded with another word.) n. (-मं) 1 A mark or sign. 2 A banner, a flag, a symbol or ensign. 3 A mark on the forehead. 4 A horn. 5 A tail. 6 Majesty, dignity. 7 Chief, principal. 8 A horse. 9 An ornament. 10 A horse's ornament. 11 A coloured mark on the forehead of a horse or bull, &c. 12 A mane. 13 A line, a row. f. (-नी) An ornament worn in the ear. E. लल to play, &c., aff. क्विप्, अम to go, to contribute to or occasion, aff. अण्; also with कनिन्, aff. ललामन्.
ललामक: ललामक n. (-कं) A chaplet of flowers falling over the forehead. E. ललाम a mark on the forehead, कन् aff. of comparison.
ललामन्: ललामन् n. (-म) 1 A mark or sign, &c.: see ललाम. 2 A species of stanza having ten syllables in the first two Pādas, eleven in the third, and thirteen in the fourth.
ललित: ललित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Wished, desired. 2 Beautiful, lovely. 3 Wanton, dallying. 4 Shaken, trembling, tremulous. 5 Graceful. 6 Gay, cheerful, careless. 7 Slow, gentle. 8 Destroyed. n. (-तं) 1 A branch of feminine action, arising from the passion or sentiment of love, and expressive of satisfaction and triumph; softness and delicacy of gesture or motion, putting on appropriate ornaments, &c. 2 Love of pleasure and gaiety. f. (-ता) 1 Musk. 2 A woman in general. 3 A wanton. E. लड to frolick, &c. or लल to desire, aff. क्त; in the first case, ड changed to ख.
लव: लव m. (-वः) 1 Cutting. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Reaping. 4 Small, little; (according to some authorities, this when used attributively changes its gender, making लवः लवा लवं; according to others it is invariably masc.) 5 Smallness, littleness. 6 A minute division of time, the sixtieth part of the twinkling of an eye. 7 A larger division of time, two Kāṣṭhas or 36 twinklings of the eye, or about 1/2 a second. 8 One of the sons of RĀMACANDRA. 9 A kind of quail. 10 Hair, wool, &c.; that which is cut or shorn from domestic animals. 11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction. n. (-वं) 1 The nutmeg. 2 Cloves. E. लु to cut, aff. अप्.
लवक: लवक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what cuts, reaps, cuts off, &c. E. लू to cut, ण्वुल् aff.
लवङ्ग: लवङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The clove tree, (Myristica caryophyllata.) n. (-ङ्गं) Cloves, the fruit. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्; also with कन् added, लवङ्गक.
लवण: लवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Salt, saline. 2 Handsome, beautiful. n. (-णं) 1 Sea salt. 2 Rock or fossile salt. 3 Factitious salt, or salt obtained by boiling clay found near the sea-shore, or any earth impregnated with saline particles. m. (-णः) 1 The saline or salt taste, saltness. 2 The sea of salt water. 3 The name of a Rākṣasa mentioned in the Rāmāyaṇa. f. (-णा) 1 Light, lustre, beauty. 2 A small river in Tirhut. E. लू to cut, (rawness, or to assist digestion,) aff. ल्यु, and the final letter made nasal by special rule.
लवणखानि: लवणखानि m. (-निः) A salt mine in general, or the district of Sāmbher in Ajmere, celebrated for its fossile salt. E. लवण salt, and खानि a mine.
लवणसमुद्र: लवणसमुद्र m. (-द्रः) The sea of salt water. E. लवण, and समुद्र ocean.
लवणाकर: लवणाकर m. (-रः) A salt mine. E. लवण salt, and आकर a mine.
लवणोत्तम: लवणोत्तम n. (-मं) 1 Nitre. 2 Rock or river salt. E. लवण salt, and उत्तम best.
लवणोद: लवणोद m. (-दः) The sea of salt water. n. (-दं) Brine. E. लवण salt, and उद water.
लवन: लवन n. (-नं) 1 Reaping. 2 Cutting. f. (-नी) A coarse kind of custard apple, (Annona reticulata.) E. लू to cut, aff. ल्युट्.
लवली: लवली f. (-ली) A kind of creeper.
लवशस्: लवशस् ind. Piece meal, in pieces. E. लव a bit, and शसि aff.
लवाक: लवाक m. (-कः) A sickle or reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
लवाणक: लवाणक n. (-कं) A sickle, a reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, आणक Uṇādi aff.
लवि: लवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Cutting, edged, sharp, (as an instrument, &c.) E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. इन्.
लवित्र: लवित्र n. (-त्रं) A sickle, a small reaping-hook. E. लू to cut, aff. इत्रन्.
लवेप्सु: लवेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing to cut or reap. E. लव, and ईप्सु desirous.
लव्य: लव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut. E. लू to cut, यत् aff.
लश: लश r. 10th cl. (लाशयति) To be skilful or clever, to do any thing skilfully and scientifically.
लशुन: लशुन n. (-नं) Garlick. E. अश to eat, Uṇādi aff. उनन्, and लश substituted for the root; also with the vowel of the aff. long लशून n. (-नं)
लशुनीय: लशुनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Garlicky. n. (-यं) Cat's eye. E. लशुन, and छ aff.
लष: लष r. 1st and 4th cls. (लषति-त or -लष्यति-ते) To desire, to like, to love. (अभि is usually prefixed.) r. 10th cl. (लाषयति) To be skilful.
लष्व: लष्व m. (-ष्वः) A dancer, an actor. E. लष to be skilled in any art, (as dancing, &c.) and वन् Uṇādi aff.
लस: लस r. 1st cl. (लसति) 1 To embrace. 2 To sport or play. r. 10th cl. (लासयति) 1 To be skilful, to do any thing skilfully or scientifically. 2 To work. With उत् prefixed, 1 To shine, to be brilliant or splendid. 2 To be happy or delighted. With वि, To gambol, to sport, especially amorously.
लसत्: लसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) 1 Sporting, playing. 2 Shining. 3 Glancing, (as rays of light.) E. लस to sport, शतृ aff.
लसा: लसा f. (-सा) Turmeric. E. लस to sport, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
लसिका: लसिका f. (-का) Saliva, spittle. E. रस to taste, &c., aff. वुन्, and र changed to ल.
लस्ज: लस्ज(ओ ई)ओलस्जी r. 6th cl. (लज्जते) To be modest or ashamed.
लस्त: लस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Grasped, embraced. 2 Skilled, skilful. E. लस to embrace, aff. क्त.
लस्तक: लस्तक m. (-कः) The middle of a bow. E. लस्त grasped, aff. कन्.
लस्तकिन्: लस्तकिन् m. (-की) A bow. E. लस्तक the middle of a bow, and इनि aff.
लहरि: लहरि f. (-रिः-री) A large wave or surf.
ला: ला r. 2nd cl. (लाति) 1 To give. 2 To get, to receive.
लाक्षणिक: लाक्षणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Secondary, inferior, subordinate. 2 Indicatory, characteristic. 3 Technical. m. (-कः) A technical term, a word implying a definition. E. लक्षण, and ठक् aff.
लाक्षण्य: लाक्षण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Indicative, symptomatic, relating to a mark or sign, &c. E. लक्षण, and यञ् aff.
लाक्षा: लाक्षा f. (-क्षा) Lac, a red dye, or an insect which is analogous to the cochineal insect, and like it forms when dried and prepared, a dye of a red colour; the nest is formed of a resinous substance which is used as sealing wax, and is usually termed Shel lac. E. लक्ष to mark or stain, aff. अ, and अण् added, the vowel made long: or लक्ष a hundred thousand, and अण् aff.; made by a multitude of the insects.
लाक्षातरु: लाक्षातरु m. (-रुः) The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.) E. लाक्षा lac, and तरु a tree; the insect being especially found in this tree.
लाक्षाप्रसादन: लाक्षाप्रसादन m. (-नः) The red Lodh, a tree from the bark of which an astringent infusion is prepared, which is used to fix colour in dyeing. E. लाक्षा lac, and प्रसादन cleansing.
लाक्षावृक्ष: लाक्षावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Butea frondosa. E. लाक्षा the lac, and वृक्ष a tree: see लाक्षातरु.
लाक्षिक: लाक्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Made of lac, &c. 2 Relating to a large number or a lakh. E. लाक्षा, and ठक् aff.
लाख: लाख(ऋ)लाखृ r. 1st cl. (लाखति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent to. 4 To refuse or prevent.
लाघ: लाघ(ऋ)लाघृ r. 1st cl. (लाघते) To be able or competent.
लाघव: लाघव n. (-वं) 1 Health. 2 Lightness, delicacy, minuteness. 3 Meanness, insignificance. 4 Frivolity. E. लघु light, &c., and अण् aff.
लाङ्गल: लाङ्गल n. (-लं) 1 A plough. 2 The penis. 3 The palm tree. 4 A sort of flower. 5 The main beam of a house. f. (-ली) 1 An aquatic shrub, (Jussieua repens.) 2 A creeping shrub, (Commelina salicifolia.) 3 Another creeper, (Nama repens.) 4 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.) E. लगि to go, to limp, &c., Uṇādi aff. कल, and the vowel made long.
लाङ्गलग्रह: लाङ्गलग्रह m. (-हः) A ploughman. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and ग्रह who takes.
लाङ्गलग्रहण: लाङ्गलग्रहण n. (-णं) Guiding the plough, ploughing. E. लाङ्गल, and ग्रहण taking.
लाङ्गलदण्ड: लाङ्गलदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The pole or shaft of a plough. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and दण्ड a stick.
लाङ्गलपद्धति: लाङ्गलपद्धति f. (-तिः) A furrow. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and पद्धति a line.
लाङ्गलिक: लाङ्गलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a plough. m. (-कः) One of thirty-four species of the fixed, or mineral and vegetable poisons. f. (-का-की) A small creeper, commonly Lāṅgalī, (Gloriosa superba); or, (Commelina salicifolia.) E. लाङ्गली a name of several plants, aff. कन्, fem. form, or लाङ्गल, and ठक् aff.
लाङ्गलिन्: लाङ्गलिन् m. (-ली) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 The cocoanut tree. 3 A snake. E. लाङ्गल a plough, and इनि aff.
लाङ्गुल: लाङ्गुल n. (-लं) A horse's tail. E. लगि to go, aff. उलच् see the next.
लाङ्गूल: लाङ्गूल n. (-लं) 1 A hairy tail, (as a horse's, &c.) 2 The penis. 3 A granary, a basket or shed for holding corn or grain. E. लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. ऊलच्, and the radical vowel made long.
लाङ्गूलिन्: लाङ्गूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Tailed. m. (-ली) A monkey. E. लाङ्गूल a tail, aff. इनि.
लाज: लाज r. 1st cl. (लाजति) (इ) लाजि (लांजति) 1 To blame or censure. 2 To fry.
लाज m. (-जः) Grain, wetted or sprinkled. n. (-जं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. f. (-जा) or masc. plu. (-जाः) Fried grain. E. लाज to fry, aff. घञ्.
लाञ्छन: लाञ्छन n. (-नं) 1 A name, an appellation. 2 A mark or sign. E. लाच्छि to mark, aff. ल्युट्.
लाट: लाट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 1 Old or worn, spoiled, shabby, (as clothes, ornaments, &c.) 2 Childish. m. (-टः) 1 Cloth, clothes. 2 Fault, defect. 3 Idle or inebriate language. 4 Repetition of words in the same sense, but a different application. 5 The name of a country, the upper part of the Dekhin, Lār or Larice. E. लट to be childish, aff. घञ्, or लाट Kaṇḍvādi root, to live, aff. अच्, or लट childish, अण् aff.
लाटानुप्रास: लाटानुप्रास m. (-सः) A figure of rhetoric; repetition of a word in the same sense, but with a different application. E. लाट, and अनुप्रास alliteration.
लाप: लाप m. (-पः) Speaking, talking. E. लप to speak, aff. घञ्.
लाप्य: लाप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be said or spoken. E. लप to speak, aff. ण्यत्.
लाभ: लाभ r. 10th cl. (लाभयति) To throw, to send or direct.
लाभ m. (-भः) 1 Gain, profit. 2 Gain in general, acquirement, acquisition. E. लभ to get or gain, aff. घञ्.
लाभकृत्: लाभकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Gaining, making profit. E. लाभ, and कृत् who makes.
लाभलिप्सु: लाभलिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Covetous, grasping, desirous of gain or profit. E. लाभ, and लिप्सु desirous.
लाभालाभ: लाभालाभ m. (-भः) Profit and loss. E. लाभ, and अलाभ not gain.
लामज्जक: लामज्जक n. (-कं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum, a fragrant grass. E. ला what takes or removes (heat, &c.), मज्जा the pith, and कप् added.
लालन: लालन n. (-नं) Wheedling, coaxing. E. लल to sport, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
लालप्यमान: लालप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bewailing or supplicating much. E. लप to speak, freq. v., शानच् aff.
लालष्यमान: लालष्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wishing to enjoy. E. लष to desire, freq. v., शानच् aff.
लालसा: लालसा mf. (-सः-सा) 1 Ardent desire. 2 Regret, sorrow, missing, wishing for any person or object absent. 3 Soliciting, asking. 4 The longing of pregnant women. 5 Wanton sport, dalliance. E. लल to desire, to wish for, असण् Uṇādi aff. or लष to wish, or लस् to sport, aff. घञ् and टाप्, and the root reiterated, deriv. irr.
लालसीक: लालसीक n. (-कं) Sauce, gravy. E. लालसा desire, ईकन् aff.
लाला: लाला f. (-ला) Saliva, spittle. E. लल to wish, अच् and टाप् aff.
लालाटिक: लालाटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to the forehead, worn on it, belonging to it, &c. 2 Contemplating the forehead, looking at it, &c. 3 Low, vile. 4 Relating to fate or destiny. mf. (-कः-की) 1 An attentive servant, one who watches a master's countenance, and learns by it what is necessary to be done. 2 An idler, one who is unable to work. m. (-कः) A mode of embracing. E. ललाट the forehead, aff. ठक्.
लालामेह: लालामेह m. हः Passing mucous urine. E. लाला, and मेह urine.
लालाविष: लालाविष m. (-षः) An insect, whose spittle is venomous or acrid, as a spider, &c. E. लाला saliva, and विष venom.
लालास्राव: लालास्राव m. (-वः) A spider. E. लाला saliva, स्रु to distil, aff. अण्.
लालिक: लालिक m. (-कः) A buffalo. f. (-का) A jesting or evasive reply, equivoque. E. लाला saliva, ठक् aff.
लालित: लालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Loved, desired. 2 Cherished, treated tenderly. 3 Coaxed, wheedled, seduced. E. लल to desire, causal v., क्त aff.
लालित्य: लालित्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Beauty, loveliness. 2 Gaiety. 3 Gracefulness, &c. E. ललित, and ष्यञ् aff.
लालिन्: लालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Wheedling, coaxing, fondling. m. (-ली) A seducer. f. (-लिनी) A wanton. E. लल to sport, causal v., घिनुण् aff.
लालुका: लालुका f. (-का) A sort of necklace.
लाव: लाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Cutting down. mf. (-वः-वा) A sort of quail, (Perdix chinensis.) E. लू to cut, to eat (corn,) causal form, aff. अच्; also with कन् added, लावक m. (-कः)
लावण: लावण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Salted, dressed or cooked with salt. 2 Salt, belonging or relating to it, &c. E. लवण salt, aff. अण्.
लावणिक: लावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Salted, cooked or dressed with salt. 2 Relating to salt, &c. 3 Lovely, beautiful. m. (-कः) A vender of salt, a salt merchant. n. (-कं) A vessel holding salt, a saltcellar. E. लवण salt, aff. ठक्.
लावण्य: लावण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 Saltness, the taste or property of salt. 2 Beauty, loveliness. E. लवण salt, and यञ् aff.
लावण्यश्री: लावण्यश्री f. (-श्रीः) Great beauty. E. लावण्य, and श्री wealth.
लावण्यार्जित: लावण्यार्जित n. (-तं) Property belonging to a woman, consisting of that which has been presented to her at her marriage as a token of respect, as a mark of kindness, or by her father or mother-in-law. E. लावण्य loveliness, and अर्जित acquired.
लाविक: लाविक m. (-कः) A buffalo. E. लव cutting, ठक् aff.
लावु: लावु f. (-वुः-वूः) A pumpkin gourd, (Cucurbita lagenaria.) E. लू to cut, to destroy, (disease,) aff. उण्; also with कन् added लावुका, and with अ or आङ् prefixed, अलावु, आलावु.
लाव्य: लाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut, to be cut off or drown. E. लू to cut, ण्यत् aff.
लास: लास m. (-सः) 1 Dancing in general. 2 Dancing, as practised by women: see लास्य. 3 Pulse that has been steeped or slightly boiled, pea-water, &c. not thickened to the consistency of Yūṣa or pease soup. 4 Dalliance, wanton sport, &c. E. लस to sport, aff. घञ्.
लासक: लासक m. (-कः) 1 A dancer, an actor, a mime. 2 A peacock. 3 Embracing, enfolding, surrounding. 4 One who sports or gambols. n. (-कं) A turret, a room on the top of a building. f. (-लासिका or लासकी) 1 A female dancer, a Nāc girl. 2 A wanton, a harlot. E. लस to embrace, to be skilful, (in the art of dancing,) and aff. ण्वुल्.
लास्फोटनी: लास्फोटनी f. (-नी) A gimlet, an auger. E. ललन going, आस्फोटन piercing, deriv. irr.
लास्य: लास्य n. (-स्यं) Dancing in general. 2 Symphony, or union of song, dance, and instrumental music. 3 A mode of dancing; the Nāc of India, or dance practised by women chiefly, and confined to attitude and gesticulation, with a shuffling motion of the feet seldom lifted from the ground; this style is said to have been invented by PĀRVATĪ, and communicated by her to the daughter of Vāṇāsura, by whom her female friends and companions were instructed in it; as a species, it is opposed to the Tāṇḍava, the more boisterous dance of ŚIVA, and his followers or men. 4 A part or embellishment of dramatic composition, the occasional introduction of music and singing; also abrupt transition from Prākṛta to Sanscrit and Sanscrit to Prākṛta, &c. m. (-स्यः) A dancer. f. (-स्या) A female dancer. E. लम to be skilled in the art of dancing, ण्यत् aff.
लास्यक: लास्यक n. (-कं) Dancing in general, or a particular style of dancing. E. लास्य as above, कन् pleonasm.
लास्याङ्ग: लास्याङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) A part of a drama, of the Lāsya order: see लास्य. E. लास्य, and अङ्ग a part.
लि: लि m. (-लिः) 1 Weariness, fatigue. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 End, term. 4 Equality, sameness. 5 A bracelet. E. ला to take, or ली to melt, &c., aff. कि.
लिकुच: लिकुच m. (-चः) A sort of bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.) E. लकुच q. v. and इ substituted for the first vowel.
लिक्षा: लिक्षा m. (-क्षा) A nit, a young louse. E. a various reading of लिक्षा.

लिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 A nit, a young louse, or the egg of a louse. 2 A poppy seed, considered as a measure of weight, or 1/6th of a mustard seed. E. लक्ष to mark, aff. घञ्, इ substituted for the radical vowel and the deriv. irr.; also क्क being substituted for the final लिक्का, and with कन् added, fem. form, लिक्षिका again with ई substituted for the radical vowel लीक्षा, &c.
लिख: लिख r. 6th cl. (लिखति) To write. r. 1st cl. (लेखति) To go.
लिख m. (-खः) 1 Writing. 2 A writer. E. लिख to write, क aff.
लिखखत्: लिखखत् mfn. (-खन्-खन्ती-खती-खत्) 1 Writing. 2 Painting, delineating. 3 Scratching, making streaks or lines. E. लिख to write, शतृ aff.
लिखन: लिखन n. (-नं) 1 Scripture, writing. 2 A writing, a written document. 3 Scratching. 4 Scarifying. E. लिख to write, aff. क्युच्, and the vowel unchanged.
लिखित: लिखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Written. 2 Drawn, delineated, painted: (painting being considered a sort of writing) 3 Drawn as lines, scratched. 4 Scarified. n. (-तं) 1 Scripture, writing. 2 A writing, a manuscript, a written book or paper. E. लिख to write, aff. क्त.
लिखित्वा: लिखित्वा ind. Having written, delineated, &c. E. लिख to write, क्त्वाच् aff.
लिख्या: लिख्या f. (-ख्या) A poppy seed, considered as a minute measure of weight, variously estimated at four or eight Trasareṇus or motes, or the sixth part of a mustard seed, &c. E. लिख to write, क्यप् aff.
लिग: लिग(इ)लिगि r. 1st cl. (लिङ्गति) To go, to move. r. 1st and 10th cls. (लिङ्गति लिङ्गयति) To paint, to variegate. With आङ् prefixed, To embrace.
लिगु: लिगु n. (-गु) 1 The heart, the mind. m. (-गुः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A deer. 3 Part of the earth. E. लग to be near or with, Uṇādi aff. कु, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
लिङ्ग: लिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A mark, a spot, a stain, a sign, a token, &c. 2 The penis. 3 The phallus, or ŚIVA under that emblem. 4 Inference, probable conclusion. 5 The premises leading to a conclusion. 6 Nature or Prakṛti, according to the Sāṃkhya philosophy, which considers this as the active power in creation. 7 Gender, (as पुंलिङ्गः the masculine gender, &c.) 8 The order of the religious student. 9 Symptom or mark of disease. E. लिगि to go, &c., aff. अच्.
लिङ्गक: लिङ्गक m. (-कः) The elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium, &c.) E. लिङ्ग the penis, and कन् aff.
लिङ्गनाश: लिङ्गनाश m. (-शः) 1 Loss of any characteristic mark, &c. 2 Loss of vision from cataract, &c. considered to be discoloration of the pupil, either red, white, or yellow. 3 Loss of the penis. E. लिङ्ग mark (of the eye), नाश destruction.
लिङ्गवर्द्धन: लिङ्गवर्द्धन m. (-नः) The elephant or wood-apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. लिङ्ग the penis, and वर्द्धन increasing.
लिङ्गवृत्ति: लिङ्गवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A religious hypocrite, one who assumes the dress, &c. of an ascetic in order to get a livelihood. E. लिङ्ग a mark, external shew or sign, (as the clotted hair, &c.) and वृत्ति practice.
लिङ्गस्थ: लिङ्गस्थ m. (-स्थः) A religious student. E. लिङ्ग, and स्थ who stays.
लिङ्गालिका: लिङ्गालिका f. (-का) A small mouse or shrew.
लिङ्गार्चन: लिङ्गार्च्चन n. (-नं) Worship of the Liṅga or phallus. E. लिङ्ग, and अर्च्चण worshipping.
लिङ्गार्च्चन: लिङ्गार्च्चन n. (-नं) Worship of the Liṅga or phallus. E. लिङ्ग, and अर्च्चण worshipping.
लिङ्गिन्: लिङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि) 1 Having marks, &c. 2 Indicated, characterized. m. (-ङ्गी) 1 An elephant. 2 A hypocrite, a pretended devotee. 3 An ascetic. 4 A religious student. 5 A worshipper of ŚIVA in the phallic type. E. लिङ्ग a mark, and इनि aff.
लिङ्गिवेष: लिङ्गिवेष m. (-षः) 1 The dress or the insignia of a religious student, the skin, staff, bowl, &c. 2 The dress or appearance of a follower of ŚIVA. E. लिङ्ग, and वेष attire.
लिप: लिप(ञि औ)ञि औलिप r. 6th cl. (-लिम्पति-ते) 1 To increase or add to. 2 To anoint, to smear, to plaster.
लिप m. (-पः) Smearing, plastering. E. लिप to smear, aff. क.
लिपि: लिपि f. (-पिः-पी) 1 Writing in general, handwriting. 2 A writing, a written paper or book, &c. 3 Painting, drawing, 4 Smearing, anointing, plastering. E. लिप to spread (ink) Uṇādi aff. इन् with ङीप् optionally added, the radical vowel unchanged.
लिपिकर: लिपिकर m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिपि writing, and कर who executes.
लिपिका: लिपिका f. (-का) Writing or a writing. E. लिपि writing, कन् added, fem. form.
लिपिकार: लिपिकार m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिपि writing, and कार who makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.; also with ट aff. लिपिकर.
लिपिज्ञ: लिपिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who can write. E. लिपि, and ज्ञ who knows.
लिपिसज्जा: लिपिसज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Implements or materials for writing. E. लिपि, सज्जा preparation.
लिप्त: लिप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Smeared, anointed, plastered, spread. 2 Eaten. 3 Envenomed, spread or touched with any poisonous substance. 4 Embraced, united, connected with, &c. 5 Defiled or contaminated by. 6 Stained, soiled. E. लिप to smear, aff. क्त, or in the last sense ली to cling to, Uṇādi aff. त, with पुट् augment, and the radical vowel made short.
लिप्तक: लिप्तक m. (-कः) A poisoned arrow. E. लिप्त poisoned, कन् aff.
लिप्तवत्: लिप्तवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Anointed, plastered. 2 Touched. 3 Vitiated, defiled. E. लिप to smear, क्तवतु aff.
लिप्तहस्त: लिप्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having the hands stained or smeared. E. लिप्त, and हस्त the hand.
लिप्सा: लिप्सा f. (-प्सा) Wish, desire. E. लिप्स the desiderative form of लभ to get, (to wish to get,) aff. अङ् and टाप्.
लिप्सित: लिप्सित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Coveted, desired. E. लिप्स to wish to obtain, क्त aff.
लिप्सु: लिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Desirous, desiring, wishing, cupidinous. E. लिप्स desiderative of लभ, (see the last,) and उ aff.
लिम्प: लिम्प m. (-म्पः) Smearing, anointing, plastering. E. लिप to smear, (taking in its derivative forms the nasal augment,) and श aff.
लिम्पट: लिम्पट m. (-टः) A lecher, a whore-monger. E. लिपि to smear with unguents, अटच् aff.; also लम्पट.
लिम्पाक: लिम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 The lime tree, (Citrus acida.) 2 An ass. E. लिपि to smear, aff. काकन्.
लिवि: लिवि f. (-विः-वी) Writing, hand-writing, or a writing, a manuscript. E. लिप to smear (with ink), Uṇādi aff. इन्, with the vowel unchanged, and व substituted for प.
लिविकर: लिविकर m. (-रः) A scribe, a writer. E. लिवि writing, and कर who executes.
लिविङ्कर: लिविङ्कर m. (-रः) A writer, a scribe. E. लिवि writing, कृ to practise, खच् aff.
लिश: लिश(औ)लिशौ r. 4th cl. (लिश्यते) To lessen or become less. r. 6th cl. (लिशति) To go, to move, to approach.
लिष्व: लिष्व m. (-ष्वः) A dancer, an actor. E. लष to be skilled (in dancing), Uṇādi aff. क्वन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
लिह: लिह r. 2nd cl. (लेढि लीढे) To taste, to taste with the tongue, to lick.
ली: ली r. 4th cl. (लीयते) r. 9th cl. (लिनाति) 1 To join, to adhere or cling to, to be in union or connexion with. 2 To obtain. r. 10th cl. (लयति लाययति लापयति लालयति or लीनयति) To melt, to liquefy, to fuse or dissolve. With आङ्, To waste away. With प्र and वि, To acquire or gain.
ली f. (-लीः) Embracing. E. ली to embrace, क्विप् aff.
लीक्का: लीक्का f. (-क्का) A nit: see लिक्का.
लीक्षा: लीक्षा f. (-क्षा) A nit: see लिक्षा.
लीढ: लीढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Eaten. 2 Licked. E. लिह to lick or taste, aff. क्त, form irr.
लीढमुक्त: लीढमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Rejected after being tasted. E. लीढ, and मुक्त let go.
लीन: लीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Embraced, clung or adhered to. 2 Melted, dissolved. 3 Dissolved with softness, overcome with passion. 4 Diffused. 5 Effaced, wiped away. 6 Staying, being situated. 7 Left, departed. E. ली to be in contact, &c., क्त aff.
लीला: लीला f. (-ला) 1 A branch of feminine action, proceeding from love; or the imitation of a lover's manner, speech, gait, &c. by his mistress, to pass the time in his absence. 2 Play, sport, pastime in general. 3 Amorous or wanton sport. 4 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. ली embrace, ला to get or give, aff. क and टाप्.
लीलाखेल: लीलाखेल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Playful. m. (-लः) A species of the Atiśarkarī metre.
लीलायित: लीलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done or written sportively, or in the way of sport or pleasure. E. लीला used as a verb, aff. क्त.
लीलावती: लीलावती f. (-ती) A wanton or sportful woman. E. लीला, and मतुप् aff.
लीलोद्यान: लीलोद्यान n. (-नं) A pleasure ground, a garden. E. लीला sport, and उद्यान a garden.
लु: लु m. (-लुः) Cutting, lopping, shearing, reaping, &c. E. लू to cut, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made short.
लुच: लुच(इ)लुचि r. 1st cl. (लुञ्चति) 1 To cut. 2 To pare or peel.
लुच्: लुच् f. (-लुक्) Cutting off, dropping, rejecting. E. लुच to cut, क्विप् aff.
लुञ्चित: लुञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut. 2 Peeled. E. लुच to cut, क्त aff.
लुज: लुज(इ)लुजि r. 10th cl. (लुञ्जयति) 1 To give. 2 To injure. 3 To be strong. 4 To dwell. 5 To shine.
लुट: लुट(ऌ)लुटॢ r. 1st cl. (लोटति-ते) r. 4th cl. (लुट्यति) 1 To stir, to agitate. 2 To be joined or connected with. 3 To roll upon the ground. r. 1st cl. (लोटति) 1 To resist or oppose. 2 To strike again. 3 To shine. r. 6th cl. (लुटति) To embrace. r. 10th cl. (लोटयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. (इ) लुटि r. 1st and 10th  cls. (लुण्टति लुण्टयति) 1 To steal, to rob or plunder. 2 To disregard, to disobey or disrespect.
लुट्यत्: लुट्यत् mfn. (-ट्यन्-ट्यन्ती-ट्यत्) Rolling about, (in pain or grief.) E. लुट to roll about, शतृ aff.
लुठ: लुठ r. 1st cl. (लोठति) To knock down. (लोठते) To resist or oppose. r. 6th cl. (लुठति) To be connected or in contact with, to rest in or on. r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोठते लुठति) 1 To roll on the ground. 2 To flow, to trickle. r. 10th cl. (लोठयति) To rob. (इ) लुठि r. 1st cl. (लुण्ठति) 1 To be lazy. 2 To repel, to resist or oppose. 3 To go, to move. 4 To steal. 5 To be lame.
लुठत्: लुठत् mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्) 1 Rolling on the ground, falling down. 2 Flowing, trickling. E. लुठ to roll, शतृ aff.
लुठन: लुठन n. (-नं) 1 A horse's rolling himself on the ground. 2 Rolling on the ground with sorrow or vexation, &c. E. लुट or लुठ to cast one's self on the ground, aff. क्युच्.
लुठित: लुठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rolling on the ground, (as a horse, &c.) m. (-तः) A horse rolling himself on the ground, &c. E. लुठ to roll on the ground, aff. क्त.
लुड: लुड r. 1st cl. (लोडति) To agitate, to stir, to churn. r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोडति लुडति) 1 To be in connexion or contact with any thing, to join, to adhere to, to rest in or on, &c. 2 To embrace. r. 6th cl. (-लुडति) To cover, to conceal. (इ) लुडि r. 10th cl. (लुण्ठयति) 1 To be agitated. 2 To plunder.
लुण्टक: लुण्टक m. (-कः) A sort of potherb, (Chironia centauroides, &c.) E. लुटि to be prostrate, &c., aff. क्वुन्.
लुण्टा: लुण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A horse's rolling himself on the ground. E. लुटि or लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अङ् and टाप्; also लुण्ठा and लुण्ठि.
लुण्टाक: लुण्टाक m. (-कः) A robber, a thief. E. लुटि to rob, काकन् aff.
लुण्ठत्: लुण्ठत् mfn. (-ण्ठन्-ण्ठन्ती-ण्ठत्) Rolling on the ground. E. लुठि to roll, &c. शतृ aff.
लुण्ठन: लुण्ठन n. (-नं) Rolling on the ground. E. लुठि To roll on the ground, aff. ल्युट्.
लुण्ठा: लुण्ठा f. (-ण्ठा) A horse's rolling on the ground: see the last, and लुण्टा.
लुण्ठाक: लुण्ठाक m. (-कः) A crow. E. लुठि to roll on the ground, काकन् aff.
लुण्ठी: लुण्ठी f. (-ण्ठी) A horse's rolling himself on the ground. E. लुठि to roll on the ground, aff. अच् and ङीप्.
लुण्डी: लुण्डी f. (-ण्डी) Observing the rules of princely conduct, acting and judging rightly. E. लुडि to be agitated, &c., aff. अच् and ङीप्; also with कन् added, fem. form लुण्डिका.
लुथ: लुथ(इ)लुथि r. 1st cl. (लुन्थति) 1 To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. 2 To afflict. 3 To suffer pain or affliction.
लुप: लुप r. 4th cl. (लुप्यति) To disturb, to bewilder, to perplex and confound the understanding. (ऌ औ ऋ) औलुपॢ r. 6th cl. (लुम्पति-ते) 1 To cut, to divide, to cut off or down. 2 To rob.
लुप्त: लुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Gone, lost, disappeared. 2 (In grammar,) Cut, off, rejected. n. (-प्तं) Booty, plunder. E. लुप to rob, aff. क्त.
लुप्तता: लुप्तता f. (-ता) Disappearance, non-existence. E. लुप्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, लुप्तत्वं.
लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रिय: लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Deprived of funeral rites. E. लुप्त, पिण्डोदक cake and water, क्रिया rite.
लुप्तोपमा: लुप्तोपमा f. (-मा) An imperfect comparison. E. लुप्त, and उपमा simile.
लुब: लुब(इ)लुबि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लुम्बति लुम्बयति) To hurt, to pain, to afflict or torment. r. 10th cl. (लुम्बयति) To disappear.
लुब्ध: लुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Covetous, greedy, desirous, cupidinous. m. (-ब्धः) 1 A hunter. 2 A lecher, a libertine. E. लुभ to desire, to wish for vehemently, to covet, aff. क्त.
लुब्धक: लुब्धक m. (-कः) 1 A hunter. 2 A libertine, a rake, a whoremonger. 3 A covetous or greedy man. E. लुब्ध desirous, aff. कन्.
लुभ: लुभ r. 4th cl. (लुभ्यति) To desire, to covet. r. 6th cl. (लुभति) To bewilder, to perplex or delude. With प्र or सं, To attract or allure.
लुभित: लुभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perplexed, deluded, fascinated. E. लुभ to fascinate, aff. क्त.
लुल: लुल r. 1st cl. (लोलति) 1 To stir or agitate, to make tremulous. 2 To be attached to or connected with, to join.
लुलाप: लुलाप m. (-पः) A buffalo. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क, stirring, shaking, (in the mud,) आप् to get or obtain, aff. अच्; it is also read लुलाय.
लुलित: लुलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling, tremulous, agitated, stirred. 2 Heaving, panting. 3 Agreeable, pleasing, beautiful, elegant. 4 Injured, destroyed. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क्त.
लुष: लुष r. 1st and 10th cls. (लोषति लोषयति) 1 To rob, to steal. 2 To hurt, to kill.
लुषभ: लुषभ m. (-भः) An elephant in rut. E. रुष to be enraged, Uṇādi aff. अभच्, with लुष substituted for the root, and the vowel unchanged.
लू: लू(लू) r. 9th cl. (लुनाति लुनीते) To cut.
लूता: लूता f. (-ता) 1 A spider. 2 An ant. 3 Local inflammation produced by the urine of a spider. E. लू to cut, क्तन् aff.
लूतिका: लूतिका f. (-का) A spider. E. लूता a spider, कन् aff., fem. form.
लून: लून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Cut. 2 Wounded. 3 Cut off. E. लू to cut, aff. क्त.
लूनक: लूनक m. (-कः) 1 An animal. 2 Sort, species, difference. 3 A wound, a division, what is cut or broken. E. लून cut, and कन् added.
लूनि: लूनि f. (-निः) Cutting, reaping. E. लू To cut, aff. क्तिन्, and न substituted for the final.
लूम: लूम n. (-मं) 1 A tail. 2 A hairy tail, as a horse's, a monkey's, &c. E. लू to cut, aff. मन्.
लूमविष: लूमविष m. (-षः) Any animal that stings with its tail, as a scorpion, &c. E. लूम a tail, and विष venom.
लूष: लूष r. 1st cl. (लूषति) To adorn, to decorate. r. 10th cl. (लोषयति) 1 To hurt, to injure. 2 To steal, to rob.
लृञ्च: लृञ्च r. 1st cl. (लृञ्चति) To put away.
लेख: लेख m. (-खः) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A god, a deity. f. (-खा) 1 A line, a mark or row, &c. 2 Writing, hand-writing. 3 Delineation, painting. E. लिख to write, aff. घञ्; it is applied to the second sense, because the figures of the gods are written or delineated.
लेखक: लेखक m. (-कः) A writer, a scribe, a clerk, a copyist, &c. E. लिस्व to write, aff. ण्वुल्.
लेखन: लेखन n. (-नं) 1 Writing, scripture. 2 The bark of the Bhoj tree, which is used for writing on in Nepal and Upper Hindustan. 3 Vomiting. 4 The leaf of the palm tree. 5 Scraping or  cleaning the tongue. 6 Scarifying, scratching. 7 Reducing corpulency, thinning. m. (-नः) A sort of grass or reed, of which pens are made, (Saccharum spontaneum.) f. (-नी) A pen, a style. E. लिख to write, aff. of the act or instrument ल्युट्.
लेखनवस्ति: लेखनवस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Use of enemas to reduce corpulency. E. लेखन, and वस्ति a glyster.
लेखनिक: लेखनिक m. (-कः) 1 A letter-carrier, an express, a postman. 2 One who signs a paper by proxy, who makes his mark, from inability to write, &c. E. लेखन writing, and ठक् aff.
लेखनीय: लेखनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be written. n. (-यं) An accusation or defence in law, which are required to be given in writing. E. लिख to write, अनीयर् aff.
लेखर्षभ: लेखर्षभ m. (-भः) INDRA. E. लेख a deity, and ऋषभ best.
लेखहार: लेखहार m. (-रः) A letter-carrier. E. लेख a letter, हृ to convey, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, लेखहारक, or with णिनि, लेखहारिन्.
लेखित: लेखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Written. E. लिख to write, क्त aff., and the vowel changed.
लेख्य: लेख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) 1 To be written. 2 To be scarified. n. (-ख्यं) 1 A letter, an epistle. 2 A manuscript. 3 A drawing, a delineation. 4 A written accusation or defence. E. लिख to write, ख्यत् aff.
लेख्यक: लेख्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Written, in writing, epistolary. E. कन् added to the last.
लेख्यकृत: लेख्यकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done in writing, contracted, executed. E. लेख्य, and कृत done.
लेख्यचूर्णिका: लेख्यचूर्णिका f. (-का) A brush, a pencil. E. लख्य a delineation, चूर्ण to pound or grind, aff. वुन् and टाप्.
लेख्यपत्र: लेख्यपत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A leaf or sheet of any thing for writing. 2 A written paper, a writing, a letter. E. लेख्य, and पत्र a leaf.
लेख्यपत्रक: लेख्यपत्रक m. (-कः) The palm tree. n. (-कं) A leaf of the palm or any other substance used for writing on. E. लेख्य writing, पत्र a leaf, कन् aff.; books in the south of India, &c. being made of the leaves of the palmyra.
लेख्यप्रसङ्ग: लेख्यप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Written contract, record, or document. E. लेख्य, and प्रसङ्ग application.
लेख्यस्थान: लेख्यस्थान n. (-नं) An office, a counting house, &c. E. लेख्य writing or what is to be written, and स्थान place.
लेख्यारूढ: लेख्यारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Recorded, committed to writing. E. लेख्य, and आरूढ mounted.
लेप: लेप(ऋ)लेपृ r. 1st cl. (लेपते) To go, to approach.

लेप m. (-पः) 1 Plastering, smearing. 2 Food. 3 Mortar, plaster, Chunam. 4 Stain, spot, smearing. 5 The wipings of the hand which has offered funeral oblations to three ancestors, and which are considered as an oblation to ancestors in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees. E. लिप to smear, &c., aff. घञ्.
लेपक: लेपक m. (-कः) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लिप to smear, (Chunam.) ण्वुल् aff.
लेपन: लेपन n. (-नं) Smearing, plastering, anointing. E. लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
लेपभागिन्: लेपभागिन् m. (-गी) An ancestor in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees. E. लेप, and भागिन् who shares.
लेपभुज्: लेपभुज् m. (-भुक्) A paternal ancestor of the 4th, 5th, or 6th degree. E. लेप, and भुज् who eats.
लेपिन्: लेपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Who or what smears, plasters, anoints, &c. m. (-पी) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लेप to plaster, and इनि aff.
लेप्य: लेप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be spread, as unguent or plaster, to be anointed or plastered. n. (-प्यं) Plastering, spreading or smearing ointment, mortar, &c. E. लिप to plaster, ण्यत् aff.
लेप्यकृत्: लेप्यकृत् m. (-कृत्) A bricklayer, a plasterer. E. लेप्य plastering, and कृत् who makes.
लेप्यमयी: लेप्यमयी f. (-यी) A doll, a puppet. E. लेप्य plastering, मयट् aff., made of wood with a coat of plaster.
लेप्यस्त्री: लेप्यस्त्री f. (-स्त्री) A woman, perfumed with fragrant unguents. E. लेप्य plastering, and स्त्री a woman.
लेलिह: लेलिह m. (-हः) A worm breeding in the stomach. E. लिह to lick, root red., क aff.
लेलिहान: लेलिहान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Who or what licks. m. (-नः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A snake. E. लिह to lick, aff. शानच्, root reduplicate, form irr.
लेश: लेश adj. masc. only. (-शः) Small, little. subst. 1 Smallness, littleness. 2 A little. E. लिश to be small, aff. घञ्, some authorities vary the gender of the attribute.
लेष्टु: लेष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A clod of earth. E. लिश to become less or small, तुन् Uṇādi aff.
लेष्टुघ्न: लेष्टुघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A harrow. E. लेष्टु a clod of earth, and घ्न destroying.
लेष्टुभेदन: लेष्टुभेदन m. (-नः) A harrow. E. लेष्टु a clod of earth, and भेदन breaking; also लेष्टुभेदिन् and लोष्टभेदन, &c.
लेसिक: लेसिक m. (-कः) The rider on an elephant, who sits on the animal's loins.
लेह: लेह m. (-हः) 1 Food. 2 Licking, tasting. E. लिह to taste, aff. ण.
लेहन: लेहन n. (-नं) Licking, tasting with the tongue. E. लिह to taste, to lick, aff. ल्युट्.
लेहिन्: लेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Who or what licks, laps, tastes, &c. E. लिह to lick, घिनुण् aff.
लेहिन: लेहिन m. (-नः) Borax. E. लिह to lick, aff. इन.
लेह्य: लेह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be licked. n. (-ह्यं) 1 The food or beverage of the gods, nectar, ambrosia. 2 Syrup, electuary. E. लिह to taste, क्यप् aff.
लैण: लैण(ऋ)लैणृ r. 1st cl. (लैनति) 1 To go or move. 2 To command or direct an act. 3 To touch or embrace. 4 To pound or grind.
लोक: लोक(ऋ)लोकृ r. 1st cl. (लोकति) To see. r. 10th cl. (लोकयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.

लोक m. (-कः) 1 Man, mankind. 2 A world, a division of the universe; in general three Lokas are enumerated, or heaven, hell, and earth: another classification enumerates seven, exclusive of the infernal regions; or Bhūr-loka the earth, Bhuvar-loka the space between the earth and the sun, the region of the Munis, Siddhis, &c.; Svarloka the heaven of INDRA, between the sun and the polar star; Maharloka the usual abode of BHṚGU, and other saints, who are supposed to be co-existent with BRAHMĀ: during the conflagration of these lower worlds, the saints ascend to the next, or Janaloka, which is described as the abode of BRAHMĀ'S sons, SANAKA, SĀNANDA, SANĀTANA, and SANATKUMĀRA; above this, is the fifth world  or the Tapoloka, where the deities called Vairāgis reside; the seventh world, Satyaloka or Brahmaloka, is the abode of BRAHMĀ, and translation to this world exempts beings from further birth; the three first worlds are destroyed at the end of each Kalpa or day of BRAHMĀ; the three last at the end of his life, or of 100 of his years; the fourth Loka is equally permanent, but is uninhabitable from heat, at the time the three first are burning: another enumeration calls these seven worlds, earth, sky, heaven, middle region, place of births, mansion of the blest, and abode of truth, placing the sons of BRAHMĀ in the sixth division, and stating the fifth or Janaloka to be that, where animals destroyed in the general conflagration are born again. 3 Sight, seeing. 4 An element, a primary or radical part of being. E. लोक to see, aff. घ.
लोककृत्: लोककृत् m. (-कृत्) The Creator, BRAHMĀ. E. लोक, and कृत् who makes.
लोकचक्षुस्: लोकचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. लोक the world, चक्षुच् the eye.
लोकजित्: लोकजित् m. (-जित्) 1 A conqueror of the world. 2 A sage. 3 A Buddha or Bauddha deified teacher. E. लोक the world, and जित् who conquers.
लोकत्रय: लोकत्रय n. (-यं-यी) The three worlds, heaven, earth, and hell. E. लोक, and त्रय triad.
लोकनाथ: लोकनाथ m. (-थः) 1 A sovereign of the universe. 2 One of the Jaina or Bauddha saints. E. लोक the world, नाथ lord.
लोकनीय: लोकनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Visible, to be seen. E. लोक to see, अनीयर् aff.
लोकपाल: लोकपाल m. (-लः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A divinity who protects the regions, or the sun, moon, fire, wind, INDRA, YAMA, VARUṆA, and KUVERA. E. लोक the world, and पाल a cherisher; also लोकपालक.
लोकप्रवाद: लोकप्रवाद m. (-दः) Common or current report or saying. E. लोक, and प्रवाद report.
लोकप्रसिद्ध: लोकप्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Notorious, well known. E. लोक, and प्रसिद्ध celebrated.
लोकबान्धव: लोकबान्धव m. (-वः) The sun. E. लोक the world, and बान्धव the friend.
लोकमातृ: लोकमातृ f. (-ता) LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU, and goddess of wealth and fortune. E. लोक the world, and मातृ the mother.
लोकयात्रा: लोकयात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Worldly affairs, civil conduct, usage, practice. 2 Resort of men, traffic, intercourse. E. लोक, and यात्रा going.
लोकरञ्जन: लोकरञ्जन n. (-नं) Popularity, gaining public confidence. E. लोक, and रञ्जन pleasing.
लोकलोचन: लोकलोचन m. (-नः) The sun. E. लोक the world, and लोचन the eye.
लोकवाद: लोकवाद m. (-दः) Rumour, report. E. लोक, and वाद speech.
लोकवाह्य: लोकवाह्य m. (-ह्यः) An outcaste, one who observes no sort of institutes, and feeds on the flesh of horses and kine. E. लोक mankind, and वाह्य for वहिर् without, excluded.
लोकविक्रुष्ट: लोकविक्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Censured or condemned by the world. E. लोक, and विक्रुष्ट censured.
लोकविश्रुत: लोकविश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Known, famous. 2 Current. E. लोक, and विश्रुत heard.
लोकविश्रुति: लोकविश्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 Unfounded rumour or report. 2 Fame, notoriety. E. लोक the world, and विश्रुति rumour.
लोकवृत्त: लोकवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Worldly or idle conversation and intercourse, E. लोक, and वृत्त practice.
लोकात्मन्: लोकात्मन् m. (-त्मा) The universal spirit. E. लोक, and आत्मन् soul.
लोकान्तर: लोकान्तर n. (-रं) Another world. E. लोक, and अन्तर other.
लोकान्तरगत: लोकान्तरगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dead. E. लोकान्तर, and गत gone.
लोकान्तरप्राप्त: लोकान्तरप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Dead. E. लोकान्तर, and प्राप्त obtained.
लोकायत: लोकायत n. (-तं) The system of atheistical philosophy taught by Cārvāka. E. लोक the world, आङ् before यति to strive, aff. अच्.
लोकायतिक: लोकायतिक m. (-कः) A follower of the Cārvāka doctrine, an atheist, an unbeliever. E. लोकायत as above, and ठक् aff. with the vowel unchanged.
लोकालोक: लोकालोक m. (-कः) A mountainous belt, surrounding the outermost of the seven seas and bounding the world. E. लोक seeing, and अलोक not seeing; causing light and darkness, as interposed between the Dvīpas and the sun.
लोकित: लोकित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seen, beheld. E. लोक to see, क्त aff.
लोकेश: लोकेश m. (-शः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A king, an emperor. 3 A Jaina deified sage. E. लोक the world, and ईश sovereign.
लोकेश्वर: लोकेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 A king. 3 A Jaina deified sage. E. लोक the world, and ईश्वर sovereign.
लोकेश्वरात्मजा: लोकेश्वरात्मजा f. (-जा) A female deity peculiar to the Jainas. E. लोकेश्वर a Jaina sage, and आत्मजा a daughter.
लोच: लोच(ऋ)लोचृ r. 1st cl. (लोचते) To see, to perceive, to view or inspect. r. 10th cl. (लोचयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. With आङ्, To consider.
लोचक: लोचक m. (-कः) 1 A ball or lump of flesh or meat. 2 The pupil of the eye. 3 Stibium or lamp-black, &c. so used. 4 An ornament, worn by women on the forehead. 5 Blue or black vesture. 6 An ear-ring. 7 The plantain tree. 8 A bow-string. 9 A wrinkled or contracted eye-brow. 10 Folly, stupidity. 11 The rejected slough of the snake. E. लोच to see, ण्वुल् aff.
लोचन: लोचन n. (-नं) The eye. f. (-ना) A goddess of the Jainas. E. लोच to see, ल्यु or युच् aff.
लोचनामय: लोचनामय m. (-यः) Diseased affection of the eye, Ophthalmia, &c. E. लोचन the eye, आमय sickness.
लोचमस्तक: लोचमस्तक m. (-कः) A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. लोच sight, seeing, and मस्तक head.
लोट: लोट(ऋ)लोदृ r. 1st cl. (लोटति) To be mad or foolish.
लोटन: लोटन n. (नं) Tumbling, rolling. E. लुट to roll, ल्युट् aff.
लोड: लोड(ऋ)लोडृ r. 1st cl. (लोडति) To be mad, to be frantic or foolish.
लोत: लोत mn. (-तः-तं) 1 Plunder, booty, stolen goods. 2 A tear, tears 3 A mark, a spot, a sign. E. लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. तन्.
लोत्र: लोत्र n. (-त्रं) Plunder, booty, stolen goods. E. लू to cut, ष्ट्रन् aff.
लोध: लोध m. (-धः) A sort of tree: see the next.
लोध्र: लोध्र m. (-ध्रः) A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing, (Symplocos racemosa.) E. रुध to hinder, aff. रन्, and ल substituted for र.
लोप: लोप m. (-पः) 1 Rejection, cutting off in general, especially used as a grammatical term for dropping letters, syllables, &c. 2 Disappearance, destruction. 3 Erasure. 4 Annulling, cancelling. E. लुप to cut, aff. घञ्.
लोपा: लोपा f. (-पा) The wife of the Muni AGASTYA. E. लुप to disturb, aff. अच् and टाष्.
लोपाक: लोपाक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. E. लुप to cut, आकन् aff.
लोपापक: लोपापक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. f. (-पिका) A fox. E. लोप rejection (offal), आप to take, aff. वुन्.
लोपामुद्रा: लोपामुद्रा f. (-द्रा) The wife of the saint AGASTYA. E. लोप losing (reputation), अमुद्रा sad, not happy.
लोपामुद्रापति: लोपामुद्रापति m. (-तिः) The Muni AGASTYA. E. लोपामुद्रा as above, and पति husband.
लोपाशक: लोपाशक m. (-कः) A Shakāl. f. (-शिका) 1 A female Shakāl. 2 A fox. E. लोप rejection, अश to eat, aff. ण्वुल्.
लोप्य: लोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) To be rejected, erased, lost, &c. E. लुप to cut off, ण्यत् aff.
लोप्त्र: लोप्त्र nf. (-प्त्रं-प्त्री) Plunder, booty. E. लुप to cut off, ष्ट्रन् aff.
लोभ: लोभ m. (-भः) Covetousness, cupidity, intense or greedy desire. E. लुभ to desire or covet, aff. घञ्.
लोभमोहित: लोभमोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beguiled or overcome by cupidity. E. लोभ, and मोहित beguiled.
लोभविरह: लोभविरह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Free from cupidity. E. लोभ, and हिरह separate.
लोभाकृष्ट: लोभाकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Tempted or attracted by greediness or desire. E. लोभ, and आकृष्ट drawn.
लोभिन्: लोभिन् mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि) Desirous, cupidinous, covetous, greedy. E. लोभ desire, aff. इनि.
लोभ्य: लोभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Desirable. m. (-म्यः) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus mungo.) E. लुभ to covet or desire, aff. ण्यत्.
लोम: लोम m. (-मः) A tail, a hairy tail. E. लू to cut, aff. मन्.
लोमकर्ण: लोमकर्ण m. (-र्णः) A hare. E. लोम hair, कर्ण an ear.
लोमकूप: लोमकूप m. (-पः) A pore of the skin. E. लोम, and कूप a well.
लोमघ्न: लोमघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Falling of the hair, morbid baldness. E. लोम hair of the body, applied here to the hair of the head, and घ्न destroying.
लोमन्: लोमन् n. (-म) The hair of the body. E. रू to sound, मनिन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed, or लू to cut, मनिच् aff.
लोमपाद: लोमपाद m. (-दः) The name of a king of Aṅga, the eastern division of Bengal, &c.
लोमपादपुरी: लोमपादपुरी f. (-री) Campā, the capital of Lomapāda, the modern Bhāgalpur, and its vicinity. E. लोमपाद a king, and पुरी the city.
लोमविष: लोमविष m. (-षः) An animal, whose hair is supposed to be poisonous, as a tiger, &c. E. लोम hair, and विष poison.
लोमश: लोमश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Hairy, covered with or made of hair. 2 Woollen. m. (-शः) 1 A ram. 2 The name of a Ṛṣi celebrated in the Mahābhārata. f. (-शा) 1 A fox. 2 A sort of Bonduc. 3 A plant, (Leea hirta.) 4 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 5 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens) 6 A medicinal plant, commonly Mahāmeda. 7 Sida cordifolia. 8 A female demi-divine being, an attendant on DURGĀ, one of the Śākinīs. 9 Green vitriol. 10 Orris root. E. लोम hair or down, श aff.
लोमशपर्णिनी: लोमशपर्णिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Glycine debilis.) E. लोमश hairy, पर्ण a leaf, and इनि aff.
लोमशमार्जार: लोमशमार्जार m. (-रः) The pole-cat. E. लोमश hairy, and मार्जार a cat.
लोमसार: लोमसार m. (-रः) The emerald. E. लोम hair, and सार strength, essence.
लोमहर्षण: लोमहर्षण n. (-णं) Horripilation, erection of the hair of the body. E. लोम hair, and हर्षण rejoicing, supposed to be an indication of great pleasure.
लोमहृत्: लोमहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Depilatory. m. (-हृत्) Yellow orpiment. E. लोम hair, and हृत् removing.
लोमालिका: लोमालिका f. (-का) A fox. E. लोम hair, आली a line, कन् added.
लोल: लोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Shaking, tremulous. 2 Rolling, tossing. 3 Agitated, alarmed. 4 Fickle, unsteady. 5 Desiring, wishing, cupidinous. 6 Greedy. f. (-ला) 1 The tongue. 2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, or the goddess of wealth and fortune. 3 A species of the Śarkarī metre. E. लोड to be frantic, अच् aff.
लोलजिह्व: लोलजिह्व mfn. (-ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं) Greedy, insatiable. E. लोल, and जिह्वा the tongue.
लोलमान: लोलमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Rolling, tossing, rolling on the ground. E. लोड to be frantic, शानच् aff.
लोलाक्षि: लोलाक्षि mfn. (-क्षिः-क्षिः-क्षी-क्षि) Having a rolling eye. E. लोल, and अक्षि the eye; also लोलचक्षुस्, लोलनयन, लोललोचन, लोलनेत्र, and the like.
लोलिका: लोलिका f. (-का) A sort of dock or sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
लोलित: लोलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Shaken, tremulous, trembling. E. लुल to agitate, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
लोलुप: लोलुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Very desirous or covetous, wishing, longing for, greedy, insatiable. E. लुप to desire, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.
लोलुभ: लोलुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very cupidinous, excessively desirous, very covetous or greedy. E. लुभ to desire or covet, aff. अच्, and the intensitive form.
लोलुव: लोलुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Cutting much or often. E. लू to cut, freq. v., aff. अच्.
लोलूया: लोलूया f. (-या) Determination to cut. E. लू to cut, intensitive v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
लोलूयावत्: लोलूयावत् mfn. (वान्-वती-वत्) Resolved to cut or cut off. E. लोलूया, and मतुप् aff.
लोष्ट: लोष्ट r. 1st cl. (लोष्टते) To heap, to assemble, to collect or gather into a heap.

लोष्ट mn. (-ष्टः-ष्टं) A clod, a lump of earth. n. (-ष्टं) Rust of iron or iron filings. E. लोष्ट to heap, aff. अच्; or लू to cut, Uṇādi aff. क्त, with change of the radical vowel, and सुट् augment; also with कन् added लोष्टक.
लोष्टघ्न: लोष्टघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A harrow. E. लोष्ट a clod, and घ्न destroying.
लोष्टभेदन: लोष्टभेदन m. (-नः) A harrow. E. लोष्ट a clod, and भेदन what breaks.
लोष्टमय: लोष्टमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of a clod or of earth. E. लोष्ट, and मयट् aff.
लोष्टमर्दिन्: लोष्टमर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिणी-र्द्दि) Who or what breaks clods of earth. E. लोष्ट, and मर्द्दिन् who destroys.
लोष्टमर्द्दिन्: लोष्टमर्द्दिन् mfn. (-र्द्दी-र्द्दिणी-र्द्दि) Who or what breaks clods of earth. E. लोष्ट, and मर्द्दिन् who destroys.
लोष्टु: लोष्टु m. (-ष्टुः) A lump of earth. E. लोष्ट to heap, उ aff.
लोह: लोह mn. (-हः-हं) 1 Iron, either crude or wrought. 2 Steel. 3 Any metal. 4 A weapon. 5 Aloe wood or Agallochum. 6 Blood. m. (-हः) A red-coloured goat. E. ल to cut, aff. ह.
लोहकण्टक: लोहकण्टक m. (-कः) A thorny shrub. E. लोह iron, and कण्टक a thorn.
लोहकान्त: लोहकान्त n. (-न्तं) The loadstone. E. लोह iron, and कान्त in this compound a gem.
लोहकार: लोहकार m. (-रः) A blacksmith, an ironsmith. E. लोह iron, and कार who works in; also with कन् added लोहकारक m. (-कः)
लोहकिट्ट: लोहकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Rust of iron, or iron filings. E. लोह, and किट्ट soil or sediment.
लोहचूर्ण: लोहचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) Iron filings. E. लोह, and चूर्ण powder.
लोहज: लोहज n. (-जं) 1 Bell-metal. 2 Rust of iron, or iron filings. E. लोह iron, and ज produced.
लोहजित्: लोहजित् m. (-जित्) The diamond. E. लोह iron, and जित् conquering, (in hardness.)
लोहदारक: लोहदारक n. (-कं) A hell. E. लोह, and दारक what tears.
लोहद्राविन्: लोहद्राविन् m. (-वी) Borax. E. लोह metal, and द्राविन् what fuses.
लोहनाल: लोहनाल m. (-लः) An iron arrow. E. लोह iron, and नाल a stalk.
लोहपृष्ठ: लोहपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A heron. E. लोह iron, and पृष्ठ the back.
लोहप्रतिमा: लोहप्रतिमा f. (-मा) 1 An image of iron. 2 An anvil. E. लोह iron, and प्रतिमा an image.
लोहमय: लोहमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of iron. E. लोह iron, aff. मयट्.
लोहमारक: लोहमारक m. (-कः) A plant, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.) E. लोह iron, and मारक destroying.
लोहराजक: लोहराजक n. (-कं) Silver. E. लोह metal, राज shining, कन् added.
लोहल: लोहल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Lisping, speaking inarticulately. 2 Iron, irony. m. (-लः) The principal ring of a chain. E. लोह iron, ला to get or be, aff. क.
लोहवर: लोहवर n. (-रं) Gold. E. लोह a metal, and वर best.
लोहवर्मन्: लोहवर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Mail, iron armour. E. लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.
लोहवर्म्मन्: लोहवर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Mail, iron armour. E. लोह, and वर्म्मन् armour.
लोहशङ्कु: लोहशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A hell. 2 An iron pike. E. लोह, and शङ्कु a pike.
लोहश्लेषण: लोहश्लेषण m. (-णः) Borax. E. लोह metal, श्चिष to embrace, to lay hold of, and ल्युट् aff.
लोहाभिसार: लोहाभिसार m. (-रः) Lustration of arms, ceremonies performed on the ninth of the light half of the month Aśvin; formerly a celebration observed by princes before opening a campaign, but now usually confined to the domestic decoration and worship of the soldier's weapons. E. लोह a weapon, अभि about, सृ to go, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिहार.
लोहाभिहार: लोहाभिहार m. (-रः) Lustration of arms. E. लोह a weapon, अभि about, हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also लोहाभिसार.
लोहामिष: लोहामिष n. (-षं) The flesh of a goat with red hair. E. लोह, and आमिष flesh.
लोहिका: लोहिका f. (-का) A sort of large shallow bowl, sometimes of iron, but usually of wood and bound with iron, for the purpose of washing rice, &c. E. लोह iron, कन् aff. fem. form.
लोहित: लोहित mfn. (-तः-ता or ती-तं) Red, of a red colour. m. (-तः) 1 Red, the colour. 2 The planet MARS. 3 One of the male rivers. 4 The Rohi, a kind of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.) 5 A sort of deer. 6 A snake. 7 A deity, a demi-god. 8 A sort of bean, (Ervum hirsutum.) 9 A form of array. 10 A tree, (Andersonia Rohitaka.) n. (-तं) 1 Blood. 2 A red kind of Agallochum. 3 Saffron. 4 Red sanders. 5 War, battle. f. (-ता) 1 A woman red with anger or with colour, &c. 2 A sort of creeper, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) E. रुह to grow, इतन् Uṇādi aff., and र changed to ल.
लोहितक: लोहितक mfn. (-कः-तिका or -णिका-कं) Red. m. (-कः) 1 A ruby. 2 The planet MARS. n. (-कं) Calx of brass. E. कन् added to the preceding.
लोहितचन्दन: लोहितचन्दन n. (-नं) Saffron. E. लोहित red, and चन्दन Sandal.
लोहितमृत्तिका: लोहितमृत्तिका f. (-का) Red chalk. E. लोहित red, and मृत्तिका soil, earth.
लोहिताक्ष: लोहिताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Red-eyed. m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. E. लोहित red, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
लोहिताङ्ग: लोहिताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MARS. E. लोहित red, and अङ्ग body.
लोहितानन: लोहितानन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Red-faced. m. (-नः) An ichneumon. E. लोहित red, and आनन the face.
लोहितायस्: लोहितायस् n. (-यः) Copper. E. लोहित red, and अयस् iron.
लोहिनी: लोहिनी f. (-णी) A woman red with anger, or painted red. E. see रोहित, the fem. aff. being ङीप्, and the penultimate consonant changed to न.
लोहोत्तम: लोहोत्तम n. (-मं) Gold. E. लोह a metal, and उत्तस best.
लौकायतिक: लौकायतिक m. (-कः) An atheist, a materialist, a Bauddha. E. लोकायत a particular heterodox doctrine, and ठक् aff.; also लोकायतिक.
लौकिक: लौकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mundane, worldly, human, what prevails amongst or is familiar to mankind. E. लोक mankind, the world, and ठञ् aff.
लौकिकता: लौकिकता f. (-ता) 1 Worldliness. 2 Worldly currency, or custom. E. तल् added to the last; also लौकिकत्वं.
लौक्य: लौक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Mundane, human. E. लोक, and यञ् aff.
लौह: लौह mfn. (-हः-ही-हं) Iron, made of iron, &c. m. (-हः) Iron, f. (-हा) An iron vessel, a pot. E. लोह iron, and अण् deriv. aff.
लौहबन्ध: लौहबन्ध n. (-न्धं) An iron chain or fetters. E. लौह, and बन्ध binding.
लौहभाण्ड: लौहभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A pestle and mortar, usually of metal. E. लौह, and भाण्ड vessel.
लौहभू: लौहभू f. (-भूः) A sort of iron vessel, a boiler, a caldron. E. लौह iron, and भू being.
लौहात्मन्: लौहात्मन् f. (-त्मा) A sort of iron boiler, &c. E. लौह made of iron, and आत्मन् substance.
लौहित: लौहित m. (-तः) The trident of ŚIVA. E. लोहित, and अण् aff.
लौहितीक: लौहितीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Reddish, like or resembling red, &c. E. लोहित red, and ईकक aff. implying similarity in this compound.
लौहित्य: लौहित्य nf. (-त्यं-ती) Redness. m. (-त्यः) 1 A male river. 2 The ocean. E. लोहित as above, ष्यञ् pleonasm.
ल्पी: ल्पी r. 9th cl. (ल्पिनाति) To unite, to join, to be connected or attached to: it is also read ल्यी-ह्णी-ल्वी, &c.
ल्वी: ल्वी r. 9th cl. (ल्विनाति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To join or be connected with, to mix with, to unite. 3 To obtain: see the last. व
